items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: So I called Stovall. I said, Stovall, because I didn't know how to get in touch with Irma in California. He gave me her number.

ctx.x: Okay, yeah, okay, let me tell you what I mean by that. Let me tell you. First of all, dead and gone. Me and him, he's always talking. See, he's the book Cato. And he was getting all this money for Cato. Cato had a checking account. Had six, now that, Stovall told me that, had sixty-seven thousand dollars in it. Larry would call, hey, how much do we got over there? He's always going to say, oh man, I got, I got twenty-five hundred, I got three thousand. I'll be over there. See, but he had power of attorney. Larry…
Yeah, I wonder what the hell he wanted to hear. Uh huh.
